nodes.name: Read RSS feed
nodes.notes: One copy of this node per feed. Set the real feed URL, then duplicate this whole workflow per platform (TenderBulletins / TenderFlow / SA-Tenders per the seed data) and set PLATFORM_ID below to match.

nodes.name: POST platform health
nodes.notes: "The failure that matters": this always reports success=true because the RSS read itself succeeded. Wire a second branch off Read RSS feed's error output to call this with success=false so a broken feed actually flips platform health.
